title: Sensex Expiry Day: Date, Timing & 2026 Trading Guide
summary: Sensex options expire every Thursday on BSE. See the next Sensex expiry date, the full 2026 monthly calendar, holiday shifts and expiry-day timings.

## When Is Sensex Expiry Day?


Sensex weekly options expire every Thursday on BSE. Monthly Sensex contracts expire on the last Thursday of the month. If Thursday is a trading holiday, expiry moves to the previous trading day. This schedule has applied since September 2025.


-


**Weekly expiry:** every Thursday.


-


**Monthly expiry:** the last Thursday of the month.


-


**Holiday rule:** if Thursday is a holiday, expiry moves to the previous trading day, usually Wednesday.


-


**Trading hours:** 9:15 AM to 3:30 PM IST.

## What Happens on Sensex Expiry Day?


Sensex expiry day is the last trading day of a Sensex options or futures contract. On that day, open positions are settled under BSE’s rules.


With so little time left, four things move option prices faster than usual:


-


**Time decay:** An option loses time value quickly near expiry. If the Sensex stays flat, a bought option can lose value even when your view is right.


-


**Delta:** Options close to the money react strongly to small Sensex moves.


-


**Gamma:** Delta itself changes fast, especially for at-the-money options, so your position can swing quickly.


-


**Implied volatility:** A change in IV can raise or lower premiums even when the Sensex barely moves.

### Sensex Expiry Day Trading Strategies


There is no single best expiry strategy. The right one depends on your market view and how much risk you can take.


Strategy


When traders use it


Main risk


Long call or put


They expect a clear move up or down


The move must happen fast, or time decay erodes the premium


Long straddle


They expect a big move but are unsure of the direction


Sensex must move enough to cover both premiums


Short straddle


They expect Sensex to stay in a tight range


A sharp move can cause large losses


[Iron condor](https://algotest.in/blog/iron-condor-strategy)


They expect a range but want limited risk


Losses if Sensex breaks out of the range


Rules-based directional


They want to trade a breakout of a set level


Whipsaws can trigger stop losses repeatedly

## How to Backtest a Sensex Expiry Strategy


A strategy can work on one expiry and fail on the next. Backtesting runs the same rules across many past expiry days, so you can see how the strategy really behaves.


For example, you can test a Sensex[option buying strategy](https://algotest.in/blog/options-trading-strategies) with a fixed entry time, strike, stop loss and target. Then compare entering at 9:30 AM, 10:00 AM or 11:00 AM, and review:


-


The win rate shows how often the strategy made money.


-


Average P&L and profit factor show how big the wins were compared with the losses.


-


Maximum drawdown shows the worst losing run you would have faced.


-


The best and worst expiry sessions show the range of outcomes.

## Sensex Expiry Day Checklist


-


Confirm the exact expiry date on BSE, especially in holiday weeks.


-


Set your maximum loss before you enter.


-


Do not buy an option only because its premium looks cheap.


-


Size your position to your risk limit, not to the premium.


-


Remember that selling options can cause large losses in a sharp move.


-


Set a limit on the number of trades so a fast market does not push you into overtrading.


-


Follow your exit rules, even when the market moves fast.

### FAQs


#### Is today Sensex expiry?


Sensex weekly options expire every Thursday. If today is a Thursday and BSE is open, it is Sensex expiry day. If Thursday is a holiday, expiry is on the trading day before it.


#### Why is Nifty expiry on Tuesday?


Under SEBI’s 2025 rules, each exchange picks one expiry day for its equity derivatives. NSE chose Tuesday for Nifty, and BSE chose Thursday for Sensex. This took effect in September 2025.


#### Which indexes have weekly expiry?


Only Nifty 50 on NSE and Sensex on BSE have weekly options. Bank Nifty, FinNifty, Midcap Nifty and Bankex have monthly expiries only.


#### Which option expires on Tuesday?


Nifty 50 weekly options expire every Tuesday. NSE’s monthly contracts, including Bank Nifty, FinNifty and Midcap Nifty, expire on the last Tuesday of the month.


#### Has the Nifty 50 expiry day changed?


Yes. Nifty 50 expiry moved from Thursday to Tuesday in September 2025.


#### What time does Sensex expire?


Sensex derivatives trade during BSE’s regular session, from 9:15 AM to 3:30 PM IST, and settle as per BSE’s contract rules.
